verdict.rationale: Codegen documents agents that run in isolated cloud sandboxes and can be triggered programmatically through the SDK and API, including from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail. It also describes an automated PR-review flow (read diff, security scan, check coverage, post comment) and run management such as resuming paused runs, which together support autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: a dedicated automation or trigger builder, scheduled/cron runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
